However, a differential proteomics experiment was performed on pulmonary adenocarcinoma (ADC) samples to compare histological growth patterns (lepidic, acinar, papillary, solid, micropapillary). The other experiments described (HeLa dilution series, precision tests, and fresh-frozen tissue lysis) are technical validations of the pipeline and do not constitute biological perturbation/differential studies.
